name: Side-Lying Inner Thigh Lift
steps: Lie on your side with your bottom leg straight and your head supported comfortably.
Cross your top leg over the bottom leg, placing the top foot flat on the floor in front of your bottom knee.
Keep your bottom leg straight and flex your bottom foot.
Lift the bottom leg upward toward the ceiling a few inches, squeezing your inner thigh muscles.
Hold for one second at the top, then slowly lower the leg back down without touching the floor.
coaching_cues: Focus on lifting with your inner thigh rather than swinging the leg.
Keep your pelvis steady and avoid rocking backward.
Breathe out as you lift the leg and breathe in as you lower.
